document.name: ChangePassword
document.documentation: Provides a secure form for users to change their passwords. Supports authenticated changes (logged-in users providing their current password) and self-service resets (when users reset password from resetPassword.jsp and cannot provide their old password).

text.name: oldPassword
text.documentation: The old password is required, and must be right, for every password change except a reset by token (resetPassword.jsp), which cannot ask for it. The action enforces this: the reset path marks itself in the persistence stash (AppConstants.PASSWORD_RESET_STASH_KEY) and nothing else can skip the check. The attribute is not marked required here only because the reset path leaves it empty; the edit view marks it required.
